Usage: agentlocks [options] [command]

Local advisory locking for shared repository worktrees.

Options:
  -V, --version                     Print the agentlocks version and exit.
  -h, --help                        display help for command

Commands:
  acquire [options] [resources...]  Acquire advisory locks for repo-relative
                                    resources.
  expand [options] [resources...]   Atomically add repo-relative resources to an
                                    existing lock.
  refresh [options] [locks...]      Refresh a held lock lease.
  release [options] [locks...]      Release a held lock.
  status [options] [resources...]   Show active locks, optionally filtered by
                                    requested resources.
  board [options] [resources...]    Show active locks grouped by agent, with
                                    each lock's lease state and next step.
  prune [options]                   Remove reclaimable expired locks.
  identify [options]                Show detected lock agent identity.
  git                               Coordinate shared Git index operations.
  run [options] [resources...]      Acquire locks for resources, run a command
                                    after --, then release.
  edit [options] [resources...]     Acquire locks for resources and run a
                                    command after --, keeping the lock for later
                                    turns.
  commit [options] [resources...]   Lock resources and the Git index, stage and
                                    commit only those resources, then release.
  init [options]                    Initialize Agentlocks support files in the
                                    host repository.
  capabilities [options]            Print the machine-readable CLI contract.
  robot-docs                        Print agent-oriented CLI docs.
  doctor [options]                  Run read-only Agentlocks health checks.
  help [command]                    display help for command
